JavaScript with exports, verify export count

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"export function greet(name) {
  return `Hello ${name}`;
}

export const VERSION = '1.0';
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"javascript"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.exports);
}
```
